report:
KARACHI ROUND 4 (researched 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-01). Targets: (1) the Karachi private bus/minibus/coach route register; (2) SMTA Peoples Bus / EV / Pink stops and timings.

HEADLINE FINDINGS
1. Found an OFFICIAL Karachi private route list online, in the Wayback Machine: the City District Government Karachi (CDGK) "Bus Routes" page, http://www.karachicity.gov.pk/busroutes.asp, captures 2007-02-21 and 2007-08-25 (identical). It lists 86 routes with points in travel order: 32 under "Busses Routes" and 54 under "Mini Busses Routes" (no coaches). Added as system karachi-cdgk-2007 (status historical, stops_confidence medium, no coordinates). Comparison with data/systems (karachi-minibus-2010, karachi-minibus, karachi-private-buses, karachi-chinchi), by route id and stop-name overlap: 53 routes match a held route closely (overlap >= 0.8), so the 2007 CDGK page is very likely the original source behind the adiekhan 2009 blog / URC 2010 list, and those routes can now cite an official source. 27 ids are held but the 2007 alignment differs: 11-C, 20, 4, 4-K, 4-L, 5, 5-C, 6, 7-C, A-3, C-1, F-11, W-11, W-18, P-1, A-25, G-19, H, G-11, G-17, N-4, N-5, Z-2, G-7, W-22, X-10, Z-18. 6 ids are not held at all: Z-10, Y, F-18, X-B, X-17, Z-A. Per-route "corroboration" lists the matching held routes and overlap.
   An earlier version of the page (2006-12-31) was a form with a Bus / Mini Busses / UTS selector; only the Bus list was ever archived (POST results), so the UTS (Green Bus) list is not recoverable.
2. Found official Karachi Green Bus Company (CDGK Urban Transport Scheme) fare charts with ordered stops and cumulative km: http://www.karachicity.gov.pk/fare.xls (Wayback 2005-04-07): UTS-4 / G-2 Sea View - 4K Chowrangi (31 stops, 37.2 km) and UTS-19 / G-1 Safoora Goth - Tower (32 stops, 25.3 km), Rs 10/15/20. Added as system karachi-green-bus-2005 (historical; service defunct).
3. SMTA: smta.gos.pk now has 30 per-route pages (https://smta.gos.pk/routes/1 ... /30; robots.txt allows all). Each page gives network (Pink Bus / People's Bus Service / EV-Bus / Double Decker), status, distance, bus type (12 m / 9 m) and a numbered "Route Path". The numbered path is just the directory's "via" text split at commas (8-18 points). It is SHORTER than the stop lists already in data/systems for every active Karachi route, so no replace_existing is proposed. New: the three inactive routes R5 (Surjani - Masroor, 28.2 km), R6 (Gulshan-e-Bihar Orangi - Singer Chowrangi, 29.6 km), R7 (Mausamiyat - Gulshan-e-Ghazi) are added to karachi-pbs as status suspended, merge_action add (they are not in data/systems or research/incoming). Pages label R1, R2, R3, R9, R10 as "Pink Bus" network (matches karachi-pink-bus). The site loads no JSON or API: the route finder is server-rendered HTML with an Alpine.js text filter (x-data city/q). Outside Karachi the pages give HYD-01, HYD-02, HYD-03 (Inactive), LRK-01, SUK-01, Mirpur Khas, SBA, Shikarpur, Khairpur 01/02 with via lists and km (not added; out of scope).
4. Timings: no official per-route timetable, first/last bus or headway exists online for PBS / EV / Pink. Found: double-decker 06:00-22:00 (Aaj 1 Jan 2026, opening section); EV-5 first departures 06:00/07:00 (SMTA notice 2024, already in notes); Pink 07:00-20:00 with 20 min peak / 60 min off-peak headway (BOL 2024, unofficial). Written to karachi-round4-timings.json (7 rows). Also seen, not written: Hamariweb Oct 2026 / Think Transportation general PBS 07:00-22:00, 15 min peak, 30 min off-peak (already in system hours notes); Ramadan 2025 temporary hours 07:00-01:00 (Times of Karachi).

REGISTER: WHAT EXISTS AND WHAT DOES NOT
- Permit counts found (no route lists): CDGK Urban Bus Scheme page (eip-ubs, Wayback 2004): 403 classified routes (110 bus, 197 minibus, 96 coach), 219 operative, 7,602 permits; 171 bus/minibus termini, city divided into 31 zones; "18 high travel demand corridors (Annexure A)" - the annexure was not on the page. Sindh Transport Dept route_text.html (Wayback 2012, data Apr-Aug 2008): DRTA Karachi permits: 5,929 minibus, 3,367 coach, 5,297 bus, 262 UTS. transport.sindh.gov.pk/rta (Wayback 2024): RTA Karachi permits issued: bus 1,986, minibus 4,387, coach 2,737, Qingqi 224; procedure: every new stage-carriage route is advertised in English/Urdu/Sindhi papers for objections (15 days), then classified by the RTA Board. So individual route classifications appear only as newspaper notices and Board minutes, not as a published register.
- 2022 RTA/Transport Dept notification of nine Peoples Intra-District routes (ARY, ~Sep 2022; Balochistan Times via vLex 2022-09-19) lists the original 2022 PBS numbering (Route 8 Gulshan-e-Hadeed - Malir City, Route 9 Numaish - Sea View, etc.); historical, used only in R5-R7 notes.
- RTA Board meeting 2026-08-05/06 (Dawn 2020846, ProPakistani, The News 1430418): decided to revise the bus route policy, prioritise permits for underserved suburbs; no route list or count published.
- CDGK RSOQ 2009 (267 routes / 12,399 permits, cited by JICA KTIP) and the Confirmatory Green Routes Study (Exponent Engineers 2008/2010): NOT online anywhere searched. JICA lists "Green Route Confirmatory Study for Karachi (2008)" by title only.
- URC library catalogue 2026 (https://urckarachi.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/LAB-2026-UPDATE_compressed.pdf) lists paper-only items worth a visit: TRAN-144 "List of private bus routes plying in Karachi" (Karachi Transport Ittehad / URC, undated); TRAN-242 "Karachi Bus Owners Association bus fares for Karachi city routes, April 2011"; TRAN-041 "Bus terminals in Karachi 1999" (missing); KMP-015 "Bus and tram travel in Karachi" (Master Plan 1972, routes and frequencies). None is digitised.

DOCUMENTS CHECKED (URL - what it held)
- web.archive.org CDX for karachicity.gov.pk (2,054 URLs) - transport pages: busroutes.asp (86 routes, used), busroutes.asp?LstIns=bus (2006 form version), eip-localbus (terminal project, 171 termini), eip-ubs (UTS scheme, permit counts), eip-trans-need, routmaps.htm (two route-map images 2B and 4C only), fareslist.htm (link to fare.xls), fare.xls (Green Bus fare charts, used). DNN-era CDGK site (2008-11) has no transport pages archived.
- https://transport.sindh.gov.pk (Wayback CDX 225 URLs): /rta (procedure, permit counts), /list-of-vehicles (empty), /sindh-peoples-intra-district-project, /notifications, elfinder files (MVO 1965, CNG ban, ADP, tender notices, Urban Transport Policy) - no route list. /minister (2008 permit counts, already known).
- http://www.sindh.gov.pk/dpt/Transport (Wayback 2009-2016): route.html / route_text.html (permit statement 2008), fares_text.pdf, list of vehicles.pdf, TOTAL-TPT-NOTIFICATIONS.pdf (title only) - no route list.
- https://smta.sindh.gov.pk (old SMTA site, Wayback CDX 534 URLs): /people-bus-service (2024 table: Red 185 buses / 9 routes / 211 km; Pink 18 / 2 / 67 km; EV 40 / 3 / 84 km; 100,000 daily riders; NRTC agreement 27 Oct 2021, term to Oct 2033; route alignment only as a map image, archive copy returns 500); EV-5 launch notice (timings, used); 12 notifications notifi-1..12.pdf and Notification.pdf (scanned staff postings and the 2017 SMTA board notification - no routes); KMP Project Operations Manual 2020 (no bus routes); job and tender PDFs.
- https://smta.gos.pk/route-map and /routes/1-30 (used, see 3); https://smta.gos.pk/downloads/karachi-bus-route-map.pdf = Think Transportation map KHI-MAP-08 dated 01/01/2025 (copyright Think Transportation; no timings).
- caselaw.shc.gov.pk: CP about 2018 route-classification notification (view-file MTM1MzA3..., dismissed; no route text), CNG/route permit orders, Super Long Route Bus Owners (intercity), toll cases - no route lists. Supreme Court: only Dawn reports on RTA jurisdiction; no route list.
- PPRA Sindh: no route-rationalisation or route-survey tender found (site not reachable through search; SMTA BRT TOR mentions automating RTA route-permit management).
- Web/news: ARY nine-route notification; vLex/Balochistan Times 2022-09-19; Dawn 2020846; ProPakistani 2026-08-06; Hamariweb Karachi transport article (undated: 446 routes, 269 closed; closed minibus ids list); ARY explainer (Shehri: 329 routes needed, ~50 with buses); Aaj (double-decker 30 Dec 2025, 1 Jan 2026); BOL (pink 2024-04-25); Times of Karachi (Ramadan 2025); geo.tv and hamariweb route page returned 403.
- URC: Bus Routes Jan 2010 (already used), 1972 bus and tram study (cover only), library catalogue 2026 (leads above).

GAPS / DEFINITELY NOT ONLINE
- The current RTA Karachi route register (classified routes with alignments), CDGK RSOQ 2009, the Green Routes Confirmatory Study, the CDGK UTS route list, and Annexure A (18 corridors) of the UTS scheme: not online in any searched official site, court database, archive or NGO site. Next step: RTI request to Secretary RTA Karachi under the Sindh Transparency and RTI Act 2016; visit URC library (TRAN-144, TRAN-242).
- Official SMTA timetables, first/last bus per route and headways: not published (SMTA pages give none; app data is Kentkart, not to be used without permission). Ask info@smta.gos.pk.
- SMTA full stop lists: the official pages give only 8-18 via-points per route; the fuller lists in data/systems remain the best available.

SAFETY / FILES
- C:\tmp_r4 (my earlier scratch folder) held routmaps.htm and fareslist.htm, Wayback copies of 2003 karachicity.gov.pk pages that Defender flagged as Virus:VBS/Redlof.A. That folder no longer exists (it disappeared during the session, presumably Defender remediation); I deleted nothing.
- research/cache/round4/ contains raw Wayback HTML saved before the no-raw-HTML rule: br_0701.html, br_0702.html, br_0708.html, brbus_0612.html (CDGK busroutes.asp, 2006-2007). Scanned: no VBScript, no Scripting.FileSystemObject, only a Flash <object>. Not deleted; owner may remove them. Also there: pdfs/ (SMTA notifications, KMP POM, URC catalogue, SMTA route map PDF), png/ (renders of scanned notices), cdx_smta_sindh.txt, my scripts (parse_cdgk.py, compare.py, build.py, strip.py, pdftxt.py, pdfgrep.py, render.py, probe.py), c.txt, t.txt, empty tmp/.
- No data/systems files were edited.
